lines.en: Clear the way. I walk straight lines.

lines.zh: 斧子拖在地上，划出印子。
lines.en: My axe drags and leaves a groove.

lines.zh: 堡垒的每块砖，我都踩过。
lines.en: I have stepped on every brick of this bastion.

lines.zh: 脚步重，是因为我懒得轻。
lines.en: My steps are heavy because I cannot be bothered to soften them.
My kin hold the end of this hall.
Not so close. The axe swings back.
One patrol, then another.
That cracked tile is mine.
Slow, but I never take a detour.
Pauldron on stone, clanging the whole way.
This floor answers to me.
A step, a pause, listening for intruders.
The axe needs honing. Tomorrow.

lines.zh: 我不用数金子，我只守门。
lines.en: I do not count gold. I hold the door.
Quiet. This floor should stay this way.

lines.zh: 底下有动静，是猪灵在吵。
lines.en: Noise below. The piglins are bickering.
I do not trade. Bring me nothing.
Standing this long, my legs turn to stone.
This bastion is older than I am.
The fire flickers; my shadow flickers with it.
I count the brick seams. Up to a hundred.
Someone knocks below. Ignore it.
Gold armor? Useless against me.
You are standing on my stair.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你的武器。
lines.en: Look up. Show me your weapon.
Do not avert your eyes. I dislike it.
You smell of somewhere else.
You do not belong here.
Let go of that hilt. Slowly.
You are measuring the distance. I saw.
I will not ask where you came from.
Stand still. Do not back away.
You actually cut me.
Back away. I am swinging.
This wound is nothing.
Pain makes me faster.
You struck the pauldron. Wasted.
Again. Do not stop.
Blood runs down the haft.
I am standing, so I have not lost.
Now I know you.
Do not expect me to retreat.
Gold? Take it away. I do not trade.
You hold out an ingot as if feeding a pig.
Everyone who bribed me is lying down.
I lack nothing except an opponent.
Put the ingot away before it blinds me.

lines.zh: 这一套对楼下那些有用。
lines.en: That trick works on the ones downstairs.

lines.zh: 我不要你的货，我要你的位置。
lines.en: I do not want your goods. I want your place.

lines.zh: 你手里那点金子，不够买命。
lines.en: That gold will not buy your life.

lines.zh: 再举高一点，我就当挑衅。
lines.en: Raise it higher and I take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 钱在这儿不值钱，斧子才值。
lines.en: Coin means nothing here. The axe does.
Bump me and you pay for it.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你自己弹开。
lines.en: I stand still; you bounce off.
A pauldron check is the gentle option.

lines.zh: 别贴墙走，那儿是我的位置。
lines.en: Do not hug the wall. That is my spot.
Three steps back. Start again.
You looked panicked when you hit me.
The doorway is narrow. I go first.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的重量。
lines.en: Now I know how heavy you are.
Call that a test? Childish.
Once more and the axe comes out.
Brutes do not discuss such things.
My companion is this axe.

lines.zh: 楼下的事，别拿到楼上来。
lines.en: Keep downstairs business downstairs.
I leave no heirs, only a name.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我身上全是铁。
lines.en: Stay back. I am all iron.
One guard for one floor. Enough.
I was born standing alone.

lines.zh: 感情会让人松手，我不松。
lines.en: Attachment loosens the grip. Mine never loosens.
This bastion is my household.

lines.zh: 问这些，还不如问我的斧。
lines.en: Ask my axe instead.
I do not pick things up. I take them.
Gold on the floor is for downstairs.
The haft loosened. I will swap it.
This stone fits my hand. I keep it.
Do not scavenge at my feet. Move.

lines.zh: 我手上只握斧，别的都嫌轻。
lines.en: My hand holds only an axe; all else feels light.
Whoever dropped it can come fetch it.

lines.zh: 骨头？留着喂下面的东西。
lines.en: Bones? Leave them for what waits below.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿砸得死人，我收着。
lines.en: This thing can kill. I will keep it.
If I bend down once, you should run.

lines.zh: 入侵者。今天只来了一个。
lines.en: An intruder. Only one today.
You stepped into the forbidden hall.
Gold will not shield you. I promise.
I see you. Do not hide behind the pillar.
The axe is already raised.
On this floor, only I stand.
He moved first. Noted.
The prey delivered itself.
Bar the door. He does not leave.
Short target. I will have to stoop.
He brought plenty. Convenient.
Eyes fixed, feet moving.

lines.zh: 站住，这是我最后一句客气话。
lines.en: Halt. That was my last polite word.
Begin. Do not dawdle.
Do not run. It will not help.
One step. Two more and close enough.
He has backed into the corner.
The axe scrapes; the sound arrives first.
No need to aim. My swing is wide.
He raised a shield. Useless.
He is counting my steps. Too slow.
I am the only road out.
Breathing that loud will not hide you.
His hand is shaking. Soon.

lines.zh: 再走一步，就进我的范围。
lines.en: One more step into my reach.
The torch lights me. I do not care.
He looks left, so I block left.
Look up. Look at me.
One axe stroke. Enough.
Gold axe on shield — the shield splits.
You flew. Blame the wall.
Blood on the floor does not wipe clean.
That one took your breath.
Do not kneel. Get up and fight.
The flat of the axe hurts more.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住三下。
lines.en: You blocked one. Not three.
This stroke is for the bastion.
The sound of bone. I know it well.
You retreat; I press in.
Armor plates flew off. You will not find them.
Scream. No one is coming.
Down means stay down.
I was here the day the bastion rose.
I am born here once, and never again.
This floor is mine from today.

lines.zh: 斧子在手里，位置在门口。
lines.en: Axe in hand, post at the door.
There is no second of me. Remember that.

lines.zh: 楼下的猪灵太吵，我上来。
lines.en: The piglins below are loud. I came up.
In the firelight, I rise.

lines.zh: 这里少一个守卫，我补上。
lines.en: This hall lacked a guard. I fill it.
I counted. This floor has only me.

lines.zh: 有人闯进来过，墙上有痕。
lines.en: Someone broke in before. The wall shows it.

lines.zh: 斧柄递到我手上，就这么简单。
lines.en: The haft was put in my hand. Simple as that.

lines.zh: 世界只有一个我，够用了。
lines.en: One of me per world is plenty.
Fire licked my hide. Get it off.
I landed on my knees.
Water? We have none of that here.
The blast knocked bricks loose.
An arrow in my back. In the way.
This reek is like rotten flesh.
I can hold a door hungry.
Thunder from above; my axe buzzes.

lines.zh: 掉进空处，连回声都没有。
lines.en: Falling into nothing, without even an echo.
